market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $120 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$103-107; needs $120 high in May (~12-16% rally). Already trending higher with geopolitical premium; one supply scare in May could push it. Reasonable probability around 30-45%.
